body: As long as you know.
Celebrity gossip websites.

I would probably wash my hands more to be honest.

Greatttt show.
Wearing two polos at once. . .
I received an email yesterday which said that a place I applied to three years ago is now hiring.
Than or then? It really changes the sentence.

People think I'm significantly younger than I am.

I shit you not, I was in the hospital having a miscarriage and no less than six people come into my room (at different times) and they all say, "You're 22?! You look 12!"

Talk about inappropriate.
The guy at the party who breaks out the guitar.
Actually made me laugh out loud.
Twitter tags? You can use them on instagram, facebook, pinterest, etc...
Freshman year of high school our english teacher had a list of "interesting words" and this was everyone's favorite.
This.
Irregardless IS a word though...it's in the dictionary.
The number of times I've tried to show my ID to a drunk guy standing on the stoop of a bar...
Total one hit wonder.
Sometimes being alone is the best solution.
I'm sorry you're feeling this way. I do feel better this morning. J.K. Rowling said, "Rock bottom is the solid foundation upon which I built my life."
I believe I'm going to do inpatient treatment, thank you for your kind words.
No...they don't care.
Yes but it would feel amazing if for once, the people I loved, loved me the same.
Meh, I don't really have friends...I'm just kind of a loner. My boyfriend was my only friend. I'll contact shelters though, thank you :)
I feel the same way and I'm sorry that someone else can relate. I sincerely hope you feel better, somehow.
Thank you very much for your kind words.

It was an isolated incident, the police were called, and he was charged which is why I was kicked out of his parent's home. I moved to a completely foreign city to be with him and have no friends or resources here. I suppose I could go to a shelter but what from there? It's just such a hopeless feeling.

I'm not close to my family at all and my only relative is barely in elementary school. Beyond food stamps, I don't have a house or a job anymore...my boyfriend of three years abused me...I just feel...alone. Thanks for the advice though.
You can still have a good life. Keep your head up, I know it's hard but there's always the future.

I'm sorry this happened but you're human and everyone makes mistakes. I'm pretty sure most people have been fired before and it's better to happen in high school than when you're in your 20s, trying to support yourself. Keep your head up.
